name: geo_sum_sq_dist_roots_of_unity
statement: (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ‖z - Complex.exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * (k : ℂ) / (n : ℂ))‖ ^ 2 = 2 * (n : ℝ)
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ = 1), ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ‖z - Complex.exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * (k : ℂ) / (n : ℂ))‖ ^ 2 = 2 * (n : ℝ)
informal: The sum of squared distances from a point of the unit circle to the vertices of the regular n-gon inscribed in it is 2n — ‖z − ζ^k‖² = 2 − 2 Re(z · conj ζ^k), and Σ ζ^k = 0 for the primitive root ζ = exp(2πi/n), n ≥ 2.
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), 2 ≤ n → ∀ (z : ℂ), ‖z‖ = 1 → ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ‖z - Complex.exp (2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I * ↑k / ↑n)‖ ^ 2 = 2 * ↑n
